lines.text: The king rejoices in the LORD's strength, and the LORD has not withheld his heart's desire.
The LORD places a crown of pure gold on the king's head, and he asks for life.
The LORD cheers the king with joy on the battlefield, and the king trusts in the LORD.
The LORD will seize His enemies and place them in a fiery furnace at the time of His appearing.
The enemies' schemes will not prevail, and the LORD puts them to shame, so the people sing and praise His power.
